regions.today: Dry and cold this evening with frost developing in light winds.
regions.tonight: Tonight cloud will build from the south but occasional clear spells will persist. Remaining mostly dry with just isolated showers in the south. Another cold night with lowest temperatures of -1 to +3 degrees. Frost developing early in the night in light to moderate southerly winds.
regions.tomorrow: Tomorrow will be generally dry for much of the day with just well scattered showers. Cloudier overall, but feeling milder with highest temperatures of 9 to 11 degrees. Moderate southerly winds, fresher near coasts. Patchy rain will push in from the west later tomorrow evening.
